subject: MAP kickoff: POC gating — org bootstrap, ephemeral keys, allowlist & peering cadence
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: network-owner@halcyonhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC gating — initial ask

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the call today — Halcyon is excited to move the POC forward. To lock the MAP and schedule our first provisioning sprint we need to confirm a few gating items from Redwood:

- Org & team bootstrap: a short checklist of the org roles you need (billing owner, API key owner, technical contact).
- API keys: we prefer short-lived/ephemeral keys for the evaluation environment; is that supported? If not, we need a recommended rotation cadence.
- IP allowlist: we'll share our egress CIDR range once we have the expected Redwood IPs. Can you provide an allowlist candidate set?
- VPC peering: high-level steps and required information (AWS account IDs, VPC CIDRs, contact for network ops).

We'd like to land the gating items and sign off on the MAP by next Tuesday 2026-09-15 so we can start provisioning the week of 09/21. Also attaching a rough internal timeline from our side (attachment stub).

Best,
Alyssa
Enterprise IT Lead — Halcyon Health
attachments: halcyon_poc_timeline.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC gating — initial ask

Thanks Alyssa — great to sync. I've drafted a compact MAP worksheet (attached) that maps each gating item to owners and target dates. High level responses below and next steps.

1) Org & roles (quick checklist) — who we need from Halcyon:
   - Billing owner (for any reserved/demo credits)
   - Network owner (for peering and allowlist)
   - Security POC (for questionnaire/evidence)

   On our side, I'll be the program lead; Marissa will own network ops for the POC; Priyom will own security/compliance tasks.

2) Ephemeral API keys — yes, Redwood supports short-lived keys via our management console (token TTL configurable). For the POC we recommend 24-48h ephemeral keys for interactive evals and a rotating service key for automated ingestion.
   - Proposed default: ephemeral keys (48h) for engineers + a service key rotated weekly for CI.

3) IP allowlist — we've published a candidate set of egress endpoints for hosted POCs. See the map draft attachment for the current IP blocks we use; if you need single-IP endpoints we can provide per-region outbound proxies (note: adds latency).

4) VPC peering — two options: (A) Cross-account peering (fast) or (B) Transit via a dedicated peering VPC. For the MAP we recommend cross-account peering to AWS account 345678901234 (Redwood POC VPC). Required from Halcyon: VPC CIDR, account ID, preferred routing table.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft.xlsx (attached) — it includes an itemized checklist and a suggested timeline that hits your 09/21 provisioning start if we sign MAP by 09/15.

Next actions:
- Alyssa: confirm Halcyon billing owner + network contact and share the egress CIDR by 09/12.
- Halcyon network owner: please loop us into your firewall ops alias so we can exchange peering details.
- Marissa/Priyom: I'll schedule a 30-min technical handoff with Halcyon network/security for 09/13.

Onwards — R

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
attachments: redwood_map_draft.xlsx (attachment stub)

On Wed, Sep 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@halcyonhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the call today — Halcyon is excited to move the POC forward.

Quick notes from a networking ops perspective:

- For the POC we prefer to keep the peering non-transitive (cross-account peering). I'll provide our peering config template during the handoff.
- Ephemeral keys are fine — for the peering step we do not need long-lived keys, but we will need a service key to run smoke tests once peering completes.
- Attachment: network-diagram.png (shows recommended route table entries and security group examples).

Specific ask for Halcyon network team: please share the VPC ID + CIDR and the account ID we should peer to. If you have an existing VPN appliance, note its public IP (we sometimes need it for troubleshooting).

I'll be on the handoff call and will confirm the exact route table edits and SGs to request.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Network Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC gating — action list & timeline

Thanks everyone — consolidating final MAP items and owners. This will be the canonical thread for the gating checklist so we can close by 2026-09-30.

Consolidated action items (owners / target):
- Halcyon: confirm billing owner + firewall ops alias (Alyssa) — target 2026-09-12 (COMPLETE).
- Halcyon network (Tom): VPC ID/CIDR + account ID (COMPLETE).
- Redwood network (Marissa): prepare peering template and route table changes for 09/22 window (IN PROGRESS).
- Redwood security (Priyom): pre-fill SOC2 checklist items relevant to POC data flows and provide evidence list by 09/17.
- Rishi: upload final MAP workbook to the shared Drive and send DocuSign SOW link (by 09/17).

Attachments included in the Drive folder: redwood_map_draft.xlsx, network-diagram.png, sow-draft.pdf (please review and comment).

Risks/notes:
- If Halcyon requires single-IP outbound endpoints instead of the provided IP blocks, bring this up now; single-IP proxies add ~25-40ms to RTT and may affect latency-sensitive demos.
- Ephemeral key TTLs are configurable; if your CI requires a longer rotation, we can add a weekly-rotated service key.

Next checkpoint: 2026-09-17 for SOC2 pre-fill and DocuSign SOW. Target MAP sign-off: 2026-09-21 to enable provisioning 09/21-09/25 and cutover in the final week of September.

Thanks — R
